tool.title: Build, check and (on request) publish a layer's own site, or a branches/<branch> preview
tool.description: From a checkout whose layers arrive by remote mount: mount the pinned closure, install, run the layer's own gates (`--pre`), compose the harness chrome for THIS layer, run its source steps, build with Jekyll at the base path read from the git remote (`/<repo>`, or `/<repo>/branches/<branch>` for a preview), run the post-build steps (mount-instance-docs, pdf-viewer, set-html-lang, publish-id-lookup, rail-standalone-pages), and check that every relative or base-rooted link in every page resolves to a file under the site, reading each page with an HTML parser. Any failing step stops the run; a link that does not resolve means nothing is published. It never decides to publish: only `--publish` does, and then a root publish keeps `branches/` and `_render-log/` on the branch, and a preview replaces only its own `branches/<branch>/`.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: The layer checkout (holds `index.config.json`). Default: the working directory.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The declared layer name; must match the checkout's declaration.

inputs.name: home
inputs.description: A page that becomes the site's index.md.

inputs.name: pre
inputs.description: A package script to run in the checkout first, as `bun run <name>` (repeatable): the layer's own gates. Any non-zero exit stops the build.

inputs.name: sourceStep
inputs.description: A package script that writes into the site source, run as `bun run <name> <site source>` (repeatable).

inputs.name: siteStep
inputs.description: A package script that writes finished pages into the BUILT site, run as `bun run <name> <built site>` after Jekyll (repeatable): Jekyll drops `_`-prefixed directories, so a generator whose pages sit under one runs here.

inputs.name: staging
inputs.description: Build (and with --publish, publish) a preview of this branch at branches/<branch>/.

inputs.name: noMount
inputs.description: Use the mounts already on disk.

inputs.name: publish
inputs.description: Publish after every check passes; needs --remote.

inputs.name: remote
inputs.description: The https git URL the caller can push the pages branch to.

outputs.name: site
outputs.description: The built site directory, and its base path.

outputs.name: links
outputs.description: Pages checked, unresolved links (must be 0), files.

selection.when: Publishing a layer's site, or a branch preview of it, from an agent or a Routine: the agent-run replacement for a pages workflow.
selection.limits: Layer sites only. A FHIR IG's site (the IG pipeline layer's `stage-ig-sites`) is not built here yet; it needs the IG's FHIR packages, which some environments cannot reach.
selection.cost: A full mount, install and Jekyll build: minutes, not seconds. `--no-mount` reuses what is on disk.

remedies.none: The mount and the publish both need the git host; offline, `--no-mount` still builds and checks from what is on disk.

$comment.comment:
Owner, 2026-10-10: publishing is agent-run, never a GitHub Actions
workflow, and staging previews are agent-run too (bean `n3h9`). The
recipe lived only as prose in a publish Routine's prompt; this is it as
one Tool, the same for an agent, a person or a Routine.
